reviews.text: The widest selection of brands I've found in Birmingham and the market section for treats is fantastic for my pups. Staff are really friendly, I've yet to find a reason to go anywhere else since switching to this store.
The is a lovely store the staff are very friendly and tender to all needs I would definitely recommend this store

Wonderful store. Great range of products especially for natural feeding of pets.
The biggest bonus is the phenomenal friendly and knowledgeable staff. Highly recommend.
A good shop

The best, to be honest. I have all sorts of pets, many of them difficult to care for reptiles, not only because they're reptiles but because they've been rescued from abusive or neglectful homes - these guys always help me get what I need even if they need to order it in ASAP.

They're friendly, helpful, and always cheery (not sure what Carlos is talking about with the tattooed lady because she's my fave - I spend a fair amount of time in there and have never seen her have a negative interaction with anyone regardless of skin colour). In actuality, that review should be removed for incitement, targeting, as it could cause potential harm as it provides individual recognisable features in an accessible location with a public address without proof of incident.

Head office need to provide them with a proper cooling system because it is too hot in the store for humans. No idea how the staff cope in there and still keep smiling. I work with reptiles and it isn't that hot in the facility. If you're going to keep it that hot, get some animals in there. Sort it out, head office.
Excellent. Super friendly and knowledgeable!
Best pet shop around friendly staff always willing to help and tiff is amazing 😇 …
I visited the store today looking for some good, long lasting treats for my dogs. Tiff gave me amazing customer service and pointed me in the right direction. Safe to say the dogs were very happy

Just visited Maypole just for pets to get some treats for the dogs at my office. They are all different breeds so finding the right treats for them, I was unsure. So I asked this lovely blonde lady what she thought was best and I got some sound advice and knowledge to best help me! The doggies loved them and me for it… especially the lab Wallace!! Will be coming back again to restock! 🐶🐾
Amazing service! The staff were so helpful with all my questions:)

My husband went to get the dog some pigs ears from the baskets where he found multiple bugs amongst them and in the basket. When he told the staff member she replied "it's just wood beatles". Thanks but no thanks. I wont be infesting my kitchen with these bugs and definitely not feeding these to my dog. You need to restock pets at home and clean and disinfect the area. It's contaminated.

Been into maypole branch today, and oh my goodness are you watched so intently just because I was buying flea solution for my cat.
I appreciate its quite expensive and no doubt the store probably deals with people who want to steal the expensive items, but I have to say I am NOT one of them! Can you make sure that you don't treat all your customers like criminals when buying things that are a little expensive. Both staff were straight over by me or right behind me at different times, I knew what they were doing but chose to try and ignore how uncomfortable they were making me feel, I PAID for my goods as I would in ANY shop and  I will shop elsewhere for my pet because it was totally unacceptable to be treated like this,
In fact if you think every single customer is a criminal and trying to steal more expensive cat solution then move them away from customers reach.
NOT a good shopping experience, won't waste my money with your company I will go elsewhere where you are treated with a bit more decency!! 😡

It seems that my experience was rare here. I went in with my white mother, I am mixed race, while my mother was looking around at the rodent supplies, I was having a look at the toys for my dog, I could feel the staff watching me like a hawk. It was really horrible. When I got to the till, the young tattooed girl who was serving didn't even acknowledge me when I paid for the toy I had chosen for Frida. But... My mother who was behind me at the time was greeted normally. It wasn't until I spoke to her did they realise we were together.

Absolutely outrageous!!!! I left feeling absolutely violated.

We will never go back there again, and I have told all my local dog walker friends too.

Disgusting treatment!! I can only imagine they didn't like me due to the colour of my skin.

Don't bother responding with your apologies.

You know what you did and who you are.
Very friendly and informative staff
Staff here are always so good

Amazing staff, really friendly and helpful, always smiling. Clearly a really tight head office. It's boiling in there during the summer and freezing in the winter. It's pretty much been this way since I started going there 5 years ago... always "broken". Profits over staff wellbeing as with most companies. Will update review if the store goes above 15c this winter.

We don’t visit often, but it’s always a great experience when we do. We came in today for some new gear for Teddy and were looked after by Emma and Mike, who were both so helpful. They made sure his harness was fitted properly and even gave him a few treats, which he loved! Always a friendly and welcoming place to shop.
Always get my dog food from here very convenient
Some out of date food at a high price!

Visited today for the first time in a long time. A really good selection of treats for dogs, natural treats available too like cow ears, chicken feet, rabbit ears, beef trachea, ostrich sausage plus loads more

Decent prices and friendly staff, made a real fuss of our dog!
Friendly staff, there to help.

Went in for hypoallergenic wet dog food and they were very helpful.

Our dog is an aggressive chewer and she recommended an antler. It's fabulous. Keeps our dog entertained and she's not destroyed it yet 😊

Very clean store with items easy to find and staff are very helpful.

staff very helpfully and friendly but the lack of air conditioning was so off putting as too hot to spend time with my dog looking around just ran in and out which was a shame as needed to look for new bed for him
Love these guys. Always friendly and helpful!
Always had everything I needed
Nice shop for pet owners
Great selection of treats and foods. Staff always happy and helpful
